caseName: Public Service Commission v. Wycoff Co.
caseNameFull: Public Service Commission of Utah v. Wycoff Company, Inc.
attorneys: C. W. Ferguson for the Public Service .Commission of Utah, and D. A. Skeen for Seamons et al., petitioners. Harold S. Shertz for respondent.

opinions.text: *975C. A. 10th Cir. Certio-rari granted. Counsel are requested to discuss on briefs and oral argument the question whether a single judge had jurisdiction to hear and determine this case in view of 28 U. S. C. § 2281.
